G1701.def:
ἐμ-παιγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Eze.22:4 (קַלָּסָה), Ps 38:7 B א1 קָלָה ni.), Wis.12:2, Sir.27:28, 2Ma.7:7, 3Ma.5:22 * ;]
a mocking: Hb 11:36.†
(AS)

G1702.def:
ἐμ-παίζω
[in LXX for עָלַל hithp., שָׂחַק, etc. ;]
= Attic προσ-, καταπαίζω,
to mock at, mock (Hdt.): with dative, Mt 27:29, 31, Mc 15:20, Lc 14:29 22:63 23:36; pass., Mt 2:16, Lc 18:32; absol., Mt 20:19 27:41, Mc 10:34 15:31, Lc 23:11.†
(AS)

G1703.def:
ἐμ-παίκτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Is 3:4 (תַּעֲלוּל) * ;]
a mocker: 2Pe 3:3, Ju 18.†
(AS)

G1704.def:
ἐν-περι-πατέω, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Lv 26:12 Jó 1:7, al. (הָלַךְ hithp.), Wis.19:21 ;]
to walk about in or among: before ἐν., dative of person(s), 2Co 6:16 (LXX),†
(AS)

G1705.def:
ἐμ-πίπλημι
(on ἐμπίμπ-, see LS, see word, Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω (At 14:17), [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, שָׂבַע ;]
to fill full, fill up, satisfy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), Lc 1:53, At 14:17; pass., Lc 6:25, Jo 6:12; metaphorically, with genitive of person(s), to take one's fill of: Rm 15:24 (cf. Dan LXX Su 32).†
(AS)

G1706.def:
ἐμ-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall into: before εἰς, Mt 12:11, Lc 6:39 10:36; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, 1Tm 3:6; ὀνειδισμόν 1Tm 3:7; πειρασμόν, 1Tm 6:9; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. 2Rs 24:14, 1Cr 21:13, Sir.2:18), Hb 10:31.†
(AS)

G1707.def:
ἐμ-πλέκω
[in LXX: Pv 28:18 (נָפַל), 2Ma.15:17 * ;]
to weave in, entwine; pass., metaphorically, to be involved, entangled in: 2Tm 2:4, 2Pe 2:20.†
(AS)

G1709.def:
ἐν-πνέω, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Dt 20:16, Js 10:28 ff. Js 11:11, 14 (ptcp. neut., for נֶפֶשׁ, נְשָׁמָה), Wis.15:11 * ;]
__1. to breathe on.
__2. to breathe;
__(a) absol.;
__(b) with genitive part.: figuratively, ἀπειλῆς κ. φόνου, At 9:1.†
(AS)

G1710.def:
ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon.
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;]
__1. to travel, esp. for business.
__2. to traffc, trade: Tg 4:13.
__3. C. accusative of thing(s)
__(a) to traffic in;
__(b) to import: (Os 12:1, for יָבַל hoph.).
__4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2Pe 2:3.†
(AS)

G1711.def:
ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;]
commerce, business, trade: Mt 22:5.†
(AS)

G1712.def:
ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Dt 33:19 (סָפַן), Eze.27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Is 23:17 (זָנָה)* ;]
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jo 2:16.†
(AS)

G1713.def:
ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ
(πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;]
__1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey.
__2. a merchant: Mt 13:45, Ap 18:3, 11 18:15, 23.†
(AS)

G1714.def:
ἐμ-πίπρημι,
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;]
to set on fire: πόλιν, Mt 22:7; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: At 28:6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†
(AS)

G1715.def:
ἔμ-προσθεν
adv.
of place (in cl. also of time),
[in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
__1. adverbially, before, in front: Lc 19:28; εἰς τὸ ἔ., Lc 19:4; opposite to ὄπισθεν, Ap 4:6; opposite to τὰ ὀπίσω, τὰ ἔ., Fp 3:13.
__2. As prep., before;
__(a) in front of: Mt 5:24 6:2 7:6 11:10 27:29, Lc 5:19 7:27 14:2, Jo 3:28 10:4, Ap 19:10 22:8;
__(b) in the presence of: Mt 27:11, Gl 2:14, 1Ts 1:3 2:19 3:9 3:13; ὁμολουεῖν, ἀρνεῖσθαι (Dalman, Words, 210), Mt 10:32, 36 26:70, Lc 12:8; in forensic sense, Mt 25:32 27:11, Lc 21:36, At 18:17, 2Co 5:10, 1Ts 2:19, I Jn 3:19; εὐδοκία (θέλημά) ἐστι ἔ. θεοῦ (a targumic formula; Dalman, Words, 211), Mt 11:26 18:14, Lc 10:21;
__(with) in the sight of: Mt 5:16 6:1 17:2 23:14, Mc 2:12 9:2, Lc 19:27, Jo 12:37, At 10:4;
__(d) of rank and dignity (Dem., Plat., al.; LXX, Gn 48:20): Jo 1:15, 30.†
(AS)

G1716.def:
ἐμ-πτύω
[in LXX: before εἰς, Nm 12:14 A, Dt 25:9 (יָרָק)* ;]
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66),
to spit upon: with dative, Mc 10:34 14:65 15:19; before εἰς, Mt 26:67 27:30. Pass., Lc 18:32.†
(AS)

G1717.def:
ἐμφανής, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Mq 4:1, Is 2:2 (כּוּן ni.), Wis.6:22 7:21 14:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Êx 2:14 (יָדַע ni.), Is 65:1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;]
manifest: At 10:40; metaphorically, Rm 10:20 (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†
(AS)

G1718.def:
ἐμφανίζω
[in LXX for יָדַע hi., etc. ;]
__1. to manifest, exhibit: ἐαυτόν, with dative of person(s), Jo 14:21-22 (DCG, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., to show oneself, appear: Mt 27:53, Hb 9:24 (cf. MM, Exp., xii).
__2. to declare, make known: before ὅτι, Hb 11:14; with dative of person(s), At 23:15; with accusative of thing(s), before πρός, At 23:22; κατά, with genitive of person(s), At 24:1 25:2; περί, At 25:15.†
SYN.: δηλόω, q.v (AS)

G1719.def:
ἔμ-φοβος
[in LXX: Sir.19:24, 1Ma.13:2 * ;]
__1. terrible.
__2. in fear (of Godly fear, Sir.19:24), terrified: Lc 24:5, 37, At 10:4 24:25, Ap 11:13.†
(AS)

G1720.def:
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ
(φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;]
to breathe into (cf. Gn 2:7, Wis.15:11, a1.), breathe upon: Jo 20:22.†
(AS)

G1721.def:
ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wis.12:10 * ;]
__1. innate (Wis.12:10).
__2. rooted, implanted: Tg 1:21 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1722.def:
ἐν,
prep, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with abl.).
__I. Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), in, within, on, at, by, among: ἐν τ. πόλει, Lc 7:37; τ. οφθαλμῷ, Mt 7:3; τ. κοιλίᾳ, Mt 12:40; τ. ὄρει, 2Pe 1:18; τ. θρόνῳ, Ap 3:21; τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, Rm 8:34; ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., Lc 1:1; of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, Gl 3:10; τ. νόμῳ, Mt 12:5, al.; ἐν τοῖς τ. Πατρός, in my Father's house (RV; cf. M, Pr., 103), Lc 2:49; trop., of the region of thought or feeling, ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ (-αις), Mt 5:28, 2Co 4:6, al.; τ. συνειδήσεσιν, 2Co 5:11; after verbs of motion, instead of εἰς (constructio praegnans, a usage extended in late Gk. beyond the limits observed in cl.; cf. Bl., §41, 1; M, Th., 12), ἀποστέλλω . . . ἐν, Mt 10:16. δέδωκεν ἐν τ. χειρί (cf. τιθέναι ἐν χερσί, Hom., Il., i, 441, al.), Jo 3:35; id. after verbs of coming and going (not in cl.), εἰσῆλθε, Lc 9:46; ἐξῆλθεν, Lc 7:17.
__II. Of state, condition, form, occupation, etc.: ἐν ζωῇ, Rm 5:10; ἐν τ. θανάτῳ, 1Jo 3:14; ἐν πειρασμοῖς, 1Pe 1:6; ἐν εἰρήνῃ, Mc 5:25; ἐν δόξῃ, Fp 4:19; ἐν πραΰτητι, Tg 3:13; ἐν μυστηρίῳ, 1Co 2:7; ἐν τ. διδαχῇ, Mc 4:2; of a part as contained in a whole, ἐν τ. ἀμπέλῳ, Jo 15:4; ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι, Rm 12:4; of accompanying objects or persons (simple dative in cl.), with, ἐν αἵματι, Hb 9:25; ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν, Lc 14:31 (cf. Ju 14, At 7:14); similarly (cl.), of clothing, armour, arms, ἐν στολαῖς, Mc 12:38; ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, Tg 2:2; ἐν μαξαίρῃ, Lc 22:49; ἐν ῥάβδῳ, 1Co 4:21 (cf. ἐν τόξοις, Xen., Mem., 3, 9, 2); of manner (cl.), ἐν τάχει (= ταχέως), Lc 18:8 (cf. Bl., §41, 1); of spiritual influence, ἐν πνεύματι, Rm 8:9; ἐν π. ἀκαθάρτῳ, Mc 1:23; of the mystical relation of the Christian life and the believer himself, to God and Christ (cf. ICC, Ro., 160f.; Mayor on Ju 1; M, Pr., 103): ἐν Χριστῷ, Rm 3:24, 6:11, 1Co 3:1, 4:10, 2Co 12:2, Gl 2:17, Ef 6:21, Cl 4:7, 1Ts 4:16, al.
__III. Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), by, with: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), 1Co 6:2; ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, Mt 9:34; ἐν αἵματι, Hb 9:22; ἐν ὕδατι, Mt 3:11, al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), Ap 13:10 (cf. 6:8). Allied to this usage and distinctly Semitic are the following: ἠγόρασας . . . ἐν τ. αἵματι σου (cf. BDB, see word בְּ, III, 3), Ap 5:9; ὁμολογεῖν ἐν (= Aram. אודי בּ; cf. McNeile on Mt, I.with; M, Pr., 104), Mt 10:32, Lc 12:8; ὀμνύναι ἐν (= cl. accusative, so Tg 5:12), Mt 5:34, al.; also at the rate of, amounting to, Mc 4:8 (WH; vv. ll., εἰς, ἒν), At 7:14 (LXX).
__IV. Of time,
__(a) in or during a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), Jo 11:9, al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, Mt 12:2, al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, meanwhile, Jo 4:31;
__(b) at the time of an event: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, 1Co 15:23; ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, Mt 22:28;
__(with) with art. inf.,
__(α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, Pr., 215), while: Mt 13:4, Mc 6:48, Gl 4:18, al.;
__(β) aor., when, after: Lc 9:36, al.;
__(d) within (cl.): Mt 27:40,
__V. In composition: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc.
(AS)

G1723.def:
ἐν-αγκαλίζομαι
(ἀγκάλη), [in LXX for חִבֻּק pi., Pv 6:10 24:33 * ;]
to take into one's arms: Mc 9:36 10:16.†
(AS)

G1724.def:
ἐν-άλιος, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea),
of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, Tg 3:7.†
(AS)

G1725.def:
ἔν-αντι
adv.,
a κοινή word (MM, Exp., xii),
before; as prep., with genitive: Lc 1:8, At 7:10 (WH, ἐναντίον), At 8:21.†
(AS)

G1726.def:
ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;]
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Mt 14:24, Mc 6:48, At 27:4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Sl 42:1-11), with genitive, Mc 15:39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1Ts 2:15, At 26:9 28:17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tt 2:8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: Lc 1:6 20:26 24:19 At 7:10 (ἔναντι, T), At 8:32 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1727.def:
ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;]
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Mt 14:24, Mc 6:48, At 27:4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Sl 42:1-11), with genitive, Mc 15:39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1Ts 2:15, At 26:9 28:17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tt 2:8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: Lc 1:6 20:26 24:19 At 7:10 (ἔναντι, T), At 8:32 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1728.def:
ἐν-άρχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;]
to begin, make a beginning: Gl 3:3, Fp 1:6.†
(AS)

G1729.def:
ἐνδεής, -ές
(ἐνδέω, to lack) [in LXX for חָסֵר, אֶבְיוֹן, etc. ;]
in want, needy: At 4:34,†
(AS)

G1730.def:
ἔν-δειγμα, -τος
(ἐνδείκνυμι),
a plain token, proof: 2Ts 1:5 (cf. ἔνδειξις, which refers rather to the "act of proving"; ἔ., with the passive formation, to the thing proved, see Lft., Notes, 100; M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: τεκμήριον (AS)

G1731.def:
ἐν-δείκνυμι
[in LXX for לָכַד, גָּמַל, רָאָה hi. ;]
to mark, point out. Mid„
__1. to show forth, prove: with accusative of thing(s), Rm 2:15 9:22, Ef 2:7, Tt 2:10 3:2, Hb 6:11; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Rm 9:17 (LXX), 1Tm 1:16; before εἰς, Hb 6:10 (with cogn. accusative), 2Co 8:24.
__2. to manifest (by act): with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), 2Tm 4:14 (cf. Gn 50:15, 17, and see MM, Exp., xiii).†
(AS)

G1732.def:
ἔν-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδείκνυμι),
a pointing out, showing forth, proof (see: ἔνδειγμα): Rm 3:25-26, 2Co 8:24, Fp 1:28.†
(AS)

G1733.def:
ἕν-δεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
eleven: of the eleven apostles, οἱ, ἕ., Mt 28:16, Mc 16:14, Lc 24:9, 33, At 1:26 2:14.†
(AS)

G1735.def:
έν-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Sl 119:122 (עָרַב), 2Ma.11:18 * ;]
__1. to admit, approve.
__2. to be possible; impers., ἑνδέχεται, it is possible: with accusative and inf., Lc 13:33 (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

G1736.def:
ἐνδημέω, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place),
to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, 2Co 5:6 5:9; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, 2Co 5:8.†
(AS)

G1737.def:
ἐνδιδύσκω
[in LXX: 2Rs 1:24 13:18, Pv 31:21 (לָבַשׁ), Jdth.9:1 10:3, Sir.50:11 * ;]
to put on: with dupl. accusative, Mc 15:17 (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). Mid., to put on oneself, be clothed in: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 16:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

G1739.def:
ἐν-δώμησις (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ
(δωμάω, to build),
a build­ing in: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, Ap 21:18 (see MM, Exp., xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).†
(AS)

G1740.def:
ἐν-δοξάζω
[in LXX for כָּבַד ni., Êx 14:4, 17-18, Eze.28:22, etc.; for עָרַץ, Sl 89:7; Sir.38:6, al. ;]
to glorify: pass., 2Ts 1:10-12.†
(AS)

G1741.def:
ἔνδοξος, -ον
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;]
__1. held in honour, of high repute: 1Co 4:10.
__2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., Lc 13:17; of clothing, Lc 7:25. Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, Ef 5:27 (cf. παράδοξος).†
(AS)

G1742.def:
ἔνδυμα, -τος, τό
(ἐνω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ ;]
raiment, clothing, a garment: Mt 3:4 6:25, 28 7:15 22:11-12 28:3, Lc 12:23.†
(AS)

G1743.def:
ἐν-δυναμόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jz 6:34, 1Cr 12:18 A (לָבַשׁ), Sl 52:7 (עָזַז)* ;]
to make strong, strengthen: with accusative, of person(s), Fp 4:13, 1Tm 1:12, 2Tm 4:17. Pass., At 9:22; C. dative, Rm 4:20; before ἐν, 2Tm 2:1 (ἐν Κυρίῳ), Ef 6:10 (Cremer, 221).†
(AS)

G1744.def:
ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω.
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Tm 3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
__1. with accusative of person(s), Mt 27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mt 27:31, Mc 15:20, Lc 15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 6:25, Mc 6:9, Lc 8:27 12:22, At 12:21; ptcp., Mt 22:11, Mc 1:6, 2Co 5:3, Ap 1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Rm 13:12, Ef 6:11, 14, 1Ts 5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Lc 24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1Co 15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Cl 3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Cl 3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Rm 13:14, Gl 3:27,
__2. to enter, press into: 2Tm 3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)

G1745.def:
ἔν-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδύω), [in LXX: Jó 41:13 (לְבוּשׁ), Et 5:1 * ;]
a putting on: ίματίων, 1Pe 3:3.†
(AS)

G1746.def:
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Tm 3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
__1. with accusative of person(s), Mt 27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mt 27:31, Mc 15:20, Lc 15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 6:25, Mc 6:9, Lc 8:27 12:22, At 12:21; ptcp., Mt 22:11, Mc 1:6, 2Co 5:3, Ap 1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Rm 13:12, Ef 6:11, 14, 1Ts 5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Lc 24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1Co 15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Cl 3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Cl 3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Rm 13:14, Gl 3:27,
__2. to enter, press into: 2Tm 3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)

G1747.def:
ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Js 8:7-9, Sl 10:8 (אָרַב)* ;]
a lying in wait, an ambush: At 23:16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), At 25:8.†
(AS)

G1748.def:
ἐνεδρεύω
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;]
to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), Lc 11:54, At 23:21.†
(AS)

G1750.def:
ἐν-ειλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX 1Rs 21:9 לוּט * ;]
to roll in, wind in: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), Mc 15:46.†
(AS)

G1751.def:
ἔν-ειμι
__1. to be in, within (Jó 27:3, al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, Lc 11:41 (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii).
__2. to be possible: Lc 11:41 (R, mg.).†
(AS)

G1752.def:
ἕνεκα (so Mt 19:5, Lc 6:22, At 19:32 26:21; elsewhere, prop, only before a vowel, ἕνεκεν; εἵνεκεν, originally Ionic: Lc 4:18 18:29, At 28:20, 2Co 3:10),
prep. with genitive,
on account of, because of: Mt 5:10-11 16:25 19:29, Mc 8:35, Lc 6:22, At 28:20, Rm 8:36, 2Co 3:10; ἕ. τούτου, Mt 19:5; υούτων, At 26:21; τίνος ἕ., At 19:32; before τοῦ, with inf., 2Co 7:12; οὗ ἕν., Lc 4:18
(AS)

G1753.def:
ἐνέργεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐνεργής), [in LXX: Wis.7:17, 26 13:4 18:22, 2Ma.3:29, 3Ma.4:21 3Mac 5:12 3Mac 5:28 * ;]
operative power (as distinct from δύναμις, potential power), working: of God, Ef 1:19 3:7 4:16, Fp 3:21, Cl 1:29 2:12; of Satan, 2Ts 2:9 2:11 (cf. M, Th., l.with; AR, Eph., 241 ff.; Cremer, 261).†
(AS)

G1754.def:
ἐνεργέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Nm 8:24 B (עֲבֹדָה צָבָא), Is 41:4, Pv 21:6 (פָּעַל), Pv 31:12 (גָּמַל), I Et 2:20, Wis.15:11 16:17 * ;] (for full lexical treatment, see AR, Eph., 243 ff.);
__1. intrans., to be at work or in action, to operate (opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Mt 14:2, Mc 6:14, Ef 2:2; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), Gl 2:8.
__2. Trans., to work, effect, do: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 12:11, Ef 1:11; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), 1Co 12:6, Gl 3:5, Fp 2:13; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, Ef 1:19-20 Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., Ga., 204 f.; but see AR, Eph., l.with; Milligan, Th., 28 f.; Mayor, Ja., 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), to be actuated, set in operation: 2Ts 2:7; before ἐν, Rm 7:5, 2Co 1:6 4:12, Ef 3:20, Cl 1:29, 1Ts 2:13; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), Gl 5:6; ἐνεργουμένη (M, Pr., 156), Tg 5:16 (Cremer, 262).†
(AS)

G1756.def:
ἐνεργής, -ές
(late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, Eph., 241),
at work, active, effective: 1Co 16:9, Phm 6, Hb 4:12 (Cremer, 261).†
(AS)

G1757.def:
ἐν-ευλογέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;]
to bless: pass., before ἐν, At 3:25 (LXX), Gl 3:8 (LXX) (Cremer, 770).†
(AS)

G1758.def:
ἐν-έχω
[in LXX: Gn 49:23 (סָתַם), Eze.14:4, 7, 3Ma.6:10 * ;]
__1. to hold in; pass., to be held, entangled: with dative of thing(s); jig., ζυγῷ δουλείας, Gl 5:1 (cf. MM, Exp., xii); θλίψρεσιν, 2Ts 1:4 (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with).
__2. to set oneself against, be urgent against (as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, Mk., l.with): Mc 6:19, Lc 11:53.†
(AS)

G1760.def:
ἐνθυμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;]
to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 1:20 9:4.†
(AS)

G1761.def:
ἐνθύμησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνθυμέομαι), [in Sm.: Jó 21:27, Eze.11:21 * ;]
consideration, pondering (EV, device): At 17:29; pl., thoughts, feel­ings: Mt 9:4 12:25, Hb 4:12.†
SYN.: ἔννοια, the action of the reason; while ἐνθ. is rather that of the affections (cf. Westc., Heb., l.with) (AS)

G1762.def:
ἔνι Ionic form of ἐν (ἐνί), with strengthened accent;
[in LXX: Sir.37:2, 4Ma.4:22 * ;]
= ἔνεστι,
is in, has place, can be: 1Co 6:5, Gl 3:28 (tris) Cl 3:11, Tg 1:17 (cf. Lft., Ga.; Hort and Mayor, Ja., ll. with).†
(AS)

G1763.def:
ἐνιαυτός, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for שָׁנֶה ;]
__1. prop., a cycle of time.
__2. = ἔτος, a year: Jo 11:49, 51 18:13, At 11:26 18:11, Tg 5:17, Ap 9:15; pl., of sabbatical years, Gl 4:10; ποιεῖν ἐ., to spend a year, Tg 4:13;ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐ., Hb 9:7; κατ᾽ ἐ., Hb 9:25 10:1, 3; ἐ. δεκτόν, Lc 4:19 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1764.def:
ἐν-ίστημι
[in LXX: 4Ki.13:6 A (עֶמְדָּה), 3Ki.12:24, 1Es.5:47 Et 9:6, Et 3:13, 1; 4Ma.9.1-32 * ;]
to place in; in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and in mid., intrans.;
__(a) to be at hand, impend, threaten: 2Tm 3:1;
__(b) to be present: 2Ts 2:2 (but see Thayer, see word); pf. ptcp., present: 1Co 7:26, Gl 1:4, Hb 9:9; pl., Rm 8:38, 1Co 3:22 (Cremer, 3O9).†
(AS)

G1765.def:
ἐν-ισχύω
[in LXX for חָזַק, etc. ;]
to strengthen: in spiritual sense, Lc 22:43; pass., At 9:19 (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, Gn 12:10 48:2, al.).†
(AS)

G1766.def:
ἐνατος, (Rec. ἔνν-), -η, -ον
ninth: Ap 21:20; of the ninth hour (3 o'clock, p.m.), Mt 20:5 27:45-46, Mc 15:33-34, Lc 23:44, At 3:1 10:3, 30.†
(AS)

G1767.def:
ἐννέα, οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl.,
nine: Lc 17:17; ἐνενήκοντα ἐ., Mt 18:12-13, Lc 15:4, 7.†
(AS)

G1768.def:
ἐννενήκοντα, see: ἐνεν-.
ἐνενήκοντα (Rec. ἐννεν-), οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl.,
ninety: Mt 18:12-13, Lc 15:4, 7.†
(AS)

G1769.def:
ἐνεός
(Rec. ἐνν-), -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX: Is 56:10 (אִלֵּם), Ep. Jr 41:1-18; ἐ. ποιεῖν, Pv 17:28 * ;]
dumb, speechless: At 9:7.†
(AS)

G1770.def:
ἐν-νεύω
[in LXX: Pv 6:13 10:10 (קָרַץ), Sir.27:22 A * ;]
to nod to, make a sign to: with dative of person(s), Lc 1:62.†
(AS)

G1771.def:
ἔννοια, -ας, ἡ
(νοῦς), [in LXX: Pv 1:4 2:11 3:21 4:1 5:2 8:12 16:22 18:15 19:7 23:4, 19 24:7 (מְזִמָּה, etc.), Wis.2:14, Da TH Sus 1:28* ;]
__1. thinking, consideration.
__2. a thought, purpose, design: Hb 4:12, 1Pe 4:1.†
SYN.: ἐνθῦμησις, which see (Cremer, 439) (AS)

G1772.def:
ἔν-νομος, -ον
[in LXX: Sir, Pv 1:1-33 ogue 12* ;]
__1. lawful, legal (MM, Exp., xiii): At 19:39.
__2. Of persons,
__(a) law-abiding;
__(b) under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, 1Co 9:21 (Cremer. 435).†
(AS)

G1773.def:
ἔννυχος, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:5 * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only)
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: Mc 1:35.†
(AS)

G1774.def:
ἐν-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly (29/36) for יָשַׁב ;]
to dwell in; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, 2Co 6:16; τ. πνεῦμα, Rm 8:11, 2Tm 1:14; ὁ λόγος, Cl 3:16; πίστις, 2Tm 1:5; ἁμαρτία, Rm 7:17.†
(AS)

G1776.def:
ἐν-οχλέω, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX for חָלָה ;]
to trouble: with accusative, Hb 12:15. Pass., before ἀπό, Lc 6:18.†
(AS)

G1777.def:
ἔνοχος, -ον (= ἐνεχόμενος),
(in LXX for רָשַׁע hi., etc. ;]
__1. held in, bound by: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, Hb 2:15.
__2. In law-phrases
__(a) liable to a charge or action (cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, Exp., xiii), Mt 5:21-22; before εἰς (Field, Notes, 4 f.), Mt 5:22
__(b) with genitive, of the punishment (Gn 26:11): θανάτου, Mt 26:66, Mc 14:64;
__(with) with genitive (cl. with dative„ rarely with prep.; MM, Exp., xiii), of the crime (2Ma.13:6): Mc 3:29;
__(d) with genitive, of the thing injured, guilty (absol., in Cl.): 1Co 11:27, Tg 2:10 (cf. Is 54:17; DB, ii, 268a).†
(AS)

G1778.def:
ἔνταλμα, -τος, τό
(ἐντέλλω), [in LXX: Jó 23:11 (אָשֻׁר) Jó 23:12, Is 29:13 (מִצְוָה), Is 55:11 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a precept: pl., Mt 15:9 (LXX), Mc 7:7, Cl 2:22.†
(AS)

G1779.def:
ἐνταφιάζω
[in LXX: Gn 50:2 (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, Gn 50:2 for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, Exp., xiii)* ;]
a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723),
to prepare for burial: Mt 26:12, Jo 19:40.†
(AS)

G1781.def:
ἐν-τέλλω
[in LXX, as in NT (and mostly in Hdt.), always mid., chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
-ομαι, to command, enjoin, instruct: before περί Hb 11:22; with inf., Mt 19:7; with dative of person(s), At 1:2; οὕτως, At 13:47; καθώς, Jo 14:31 (ἐντολὴν ἔδωκεν, WH); before λέγων, Mt 17:9; with inf., Jo 8:5; ἵνα, Mc 13:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 28:20, Mc 10:3, Jo 15:14, 17; before περί, with genitive of person(s), Mt 4:6 and Lc 4:10 (LXX); διαθήκην ἐ. πρός, with accusative of person(s), Hb 9:20 (LXX) (cf. Sir.45:3).†
SYN.:
κελεύω, to command, of verbal orders in general;
παραγγέλλω, to charge, esp. of the transmitted orders of a military com­mander; ἐντέλλω points rather to the contents of the command (see Thayer, see word κελεύω)
(AS)

G1782.def:
ἐντεῦθεν
adv. (ἔνθεν), [in LXX chiefly for זֶה ;]
__1. of place, hence: Lc 4:9 13:31, Jo 2:16 7:3 14:31 18:36; ἐ. καὶ ἐ. (for cl. ἔνθεν κ. ἔνθεν), on this side and on that, on each side, Jo 19:18; similarly, ἐ. καὶ ἐκεῖθεν, Ap 22:2.
__2. Of time, thereupon.
__3. Causal; hence, therefore: Tg 4:1.†
ἔνθεν,
adv., [in LXX for זֶה, פֹּה, etc. ;]
hence: Mt 17:20, Lc 16:26.†
(AS)

G1783.def:
ἐν-τευξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐντυγχάνω, which see), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:3 * ;]
__1. a lighting upon, meeting with.
__2. conversation.
__3. a petition (in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, Exp., iii): 1Tm 4:5; p1., 1Tm 2:1.†
SYN.: δέησις (which see) (AS)

G1784.def:
ἔντιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX for חוֹר, etc. ;]
honoured, prized, precious: of persons, Lc 7:2, Fp 2:29; compar., Lc 14:8; of things, metaphorically, λίθος, 1Pe 2:4 2:6" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1785.def:
ἐντολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐντέλλω, which see), [in LXX chiefly for מִצְוָה; in pl. frequently in Pss for פִּקּוּד ;]
__1. generally, a charge, injunction, order, command: Lc 15:29, Jo 10:18 11:57 12:49-50 14:31, At 17:15, Cl 4:10; ἐ. σαρκίνη, Hb 7:16, 18
__2. Esp. of religious precepts and commandments;
__(a) of God's commandments: in OT, Mt 15:3 22:36, 38 22:40 Mk 7:8-9; Mc 10:5, 19 12:28, 31 Ef 2:15, Hb 9:19; esp. of the decalogue, Mt 5:19 19:17, Mc 10:19, Lc 18:20 23:56, Rm 7:8-13 13:9, Ef 6:2; of God's command­ments in general, Lc 1:6, 1Co 7:19, 1Jo 2:3-8 Jn 3:22-24 Jn 4:21 Jn 5:2-3, Ap 12:17 14:12; collectively, ἡ ἐ. (cf. τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Jo 6:29), 1Tm 6:14, 2Pe 2:21 3:2;
__(b) of things commanded Christ by the Father: Jo 12:49-50 14:31 15:10;
__(with) of the precepts of Christ: Jo 13:34 14:15, 21 15:10, 12, 1Co 14:37.
__3. Phrases: before ἵνα, Jo 13:34 15:12, 1Jo 3:23 Jn 4:21, 2Jn.6; ἐντολὴν (ὰς) παραβαίνειν, Mt 15:3; ἀκυροῦν, Mt 15:6 Rec.; τηρεῖν, Mt 19:17 Jo 15:10, al.; ποιεῖν, 1Jo 5:2; διδόναι, Jo 11:57; λαμβάνειν, Jo 10:18, 2Jn.4; ἔχειν, Jo 14:21, Hb 7:5; ἐ. καὶ δικαιώματα, Lc 1:6; ἐντολαὶ ἀνθρώπων (of Jewish tradition), Tt 1:14; i. καινή, Jo 13:34, 1Jo 2:7, 2Jn.5.†
(AS)

G1787.def:
ἐντός
(ἐν),
adv., [in LXX: Jó 18:20, Sl 39:3 109:22, Ct 3:10; ὁ, τὸ, τὰ ἐ., Sl 103:1, Is 16:11, Da TH Dn 10:16, Sir.19:26, 1Ma.4:48 * ;]
within: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), Lc 17:21 (cf. Field, Notes, 71; Thayer, see word; ICC, Lk, l.with; Dalman, Words, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., Mt 23:26.†
(AS)

G1788.def:
ἐν-τρέπω
[in LXX for כָּנַע ni., כָּלַם ni., etc. ;]
to turn about; metaphorically, put to shame: with accusative, 1Co 4:14; pass., 2Ts 3:14, Tt 2:8; mid., to reverence: with accusative of person(s) (cl. with genitive), Mt 21:37, Mc 12:6, Lc 18:2, 4 20:13, Hb 12:9 (cf. MM, Exp., iii, xiii).†
(AS)

G1789.def:
ἐν-τρέφω
to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, 1Tm 4:6.†
(AS)

G1790.def:
ἔν-τρομος, -ον
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 10:11 (רָעַד hi.); ἔ. γίγνεσθαι, Sl 18:7 77:18 (רַעַשׁ), Wis.17:10, 1Ma.13:2 * ;]
trembling with fear (Pint.): At 7:32 16:29, Hb 12:21 (ἔκτρ-, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1791.def:
ἐν-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Jó 20:3, Sl 35:26 44:15 69:7, 19 71:13 109:29 (כְּלִמָּה)* ;]
__1. with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.).
__2. Absol., shame (Hipp.): 1Co 6:5 15:34.†
(AS)

G1792.def:
ἐν-τρυφάω, ῶ
[in LXX: Is 55:2 57:4 (עָנַג hith.), Hc 1:10 (קָלַס hith.), 4Ma.8:8, etc. ;]
to revel in: ἐν-τ. ἀπάταις, 2Pe 2:13 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1793.def:
ἐν-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 6:12-13 (קֶרֶב) Wis.8:20 16:28, 2Ma.2:25 2Mac 4:36 2Mac 6:12 2Mac 15:39, 3Ma.6:37; before κατά, 1Ma.8:32 1Mac 10:61-64 1Mac 11:25 * ;]
__1. to fall in with.
__2. to meet with in order to converse.
__3. to petition, make petition: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), At 25:24 (cf. Field, Notes, 140), Hb 7:25, Rm 8:27, 34 (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, against: Rm 11:2 (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).†
(AS)

G1794.def:
ἐν-τυλίσσω
to wrap up (LS), roll or coil about (DCG, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, Mt 27:59 (iv, Tr. [WH], cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, Exp., xiii), Lc 23:53; pass., Jo 20:7.†
(AS)

G1795.def:
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, Êx 39:30) A * ;]
to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, 2Co 3:7.†
(AS)

G1796.def:
ἐν-υβρίζω
[in OT (Al.), Lv 24:11 * ;]
to insult, mock at: Hb 10:29.†
(AS)

G1797.def:
ἐνυπνιάζω
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;]
to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., At 2:17 (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.†
(AS)

G1798.def:
ἐνύπνιον, -ου, τό
(ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for חֲלוֹם ;]
a dream: pl., At 2:17.†
(AS)

G1799.def:
ἐνώπιος, -ον
(ὤψ), [in LXX for פָּנִים, etc. ;]
face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., Êx 25:29): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive [in LXX for פָּנִים, עַיִן, etc., cf. Dalman, Words, 31 f., 209 f., and Deiss., BS., 213], in NT, most frequently in Lk, Ac, Re, never in Mt, Mk, before, in the presence of: Lc 1:19 Lc 4:7, At 4:10 At 6:5, Ap 1:4 2:14, al.; esp. ἐ. Κυρίου (θεοῦ), in the sight of God, or with God as witness or as judge, Rm 14:22, 1Co 1:29, 1Tm 2:3, Tg 4:10, 1Pe 3:4, al.
(AS)
